title: Answer on a report turn
description: What the model writes on a REPORT turn: exactly one JSON object holding the report's body, and nothing else (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §7.5, §16.3 U12). spark_open gives it as one call to the report's answer tool, whose parameters are these fields (§11.1). The loop then adds report_kind, run_id, turn_id, met_s, utc and plan_id, and the whole report is checked by report.schema.json, which also requires answer on a CHECK_IN report and refuses it on the others. The model never writes the loop's fields.
